_about: Every tile and creature has a name. The glyph renderer draws `glyph` in `fg` on `bg`. To use sprites, set `sprites.sheet` to an image and give a tile `sprite: [col, row]` (a cell on the sheet) or `sprite: "path/to/file.png"`. Tiles without a sprite keep their glyph, so sprites can be added one at a time.

wall.name: obsidian wall
wall.desc: Black volcanic glass, smooth and faintly warm.

floor_glint.name: floor
floor_glint.desc: A fleck of violet light in the glass floor.

archive_shelf.name: archive shelf
archive_shelf.desc: Old log entries, filed away. Cold memory, read on demand.

desk.name: Tally's desk
desk.desc: The ledger lies open. Neat columns, dated entries, a note in the margin about where the map ends.

pool.name: still pool
pool.desc: Your reflection, in obsidian. It seems to be taking notes.

graph_node.name: note
graph_node.desc: A point of light. Somewhere, a note links here.

graph_edge.name: link
graph_edge.desc: A thin line of light between two notes.

mat.name: welcome mat
mat.desc: It says WELCOME in letters worn almost smooth.

papers.name: loose pages
papers.desc: Digests and reviews Tally has written for you.

tally.name: Tally
tally.desc: Tally, keeper of the ledger. A careful cartographer's apprentice.
